rules.description: A higher-timeframe market-maker zone permits searching for a trade; entry requires a completed bullish intraday pattern inside it.
rules.original_explanation: لا دخول إلا بنموذج لحظي داعم للصعود
preconditions: Price is inside a valid buyer zone
trigger_conditions: A supported bullish intraday pattern completes
exceptions: Bullish engulfing is decided at its own close
rules.pseudocode: if in_valid_zone and bullish_pattern.completed and stop_pct <= 0.03: allow_entry()

rules.description: After a candle closes below the original pattern stop, mark that candle's low; final failure occurs on a close below that low.
rules.original_explanation: الشمعة التي كسرت نجعل أدناها خط فإن أغلق أدناها نفعل الوقف
applicable_strategy: All bullish patterns with false-stop-break handling
preconditions: A candle closes below original stop
exceptions: Position risk must still respect the portfolio risk policy
rules.pseudocode: if close < original_stop: final_stop = low; if later_close < final_stop: exit()

rules.description: Select a stock that rose at least 12% in 3 to 7 candles with volume breaking above its 50-period volume average, then wait for a corrective M-like structure.
rules.original_explanation: صعود ثم هبوط قريب من حرف M وننتظر المشتري
preconditions: at least one volume bar > volume_SMA50
confirmation_conditions: daily buying candle with volume or completed 30m bullish pattern
stop_conditions: below completed entry pattern; exact calibration unresolved
target_conditions: not fixed in the initial rule
exceptions: The two M halves need not be equal
rules.mathematical_definition: max(close[0:n])/close[0]-1 >= 0.12 for n in [3,7]; volume breakout threshold requires calibration
rules.pseudocode: candidate = rise_pct >= .12 and 3 <= rise_bars <= 7 and volume_breaks_sma50; wait_for_buyer(candidate)

rules.description: Positive divergence, Fibonacci 38.2/50/61.8, or a moving average may strengthen the early entry but do not replace buyer confirmation.
rules.original_explanation: نحاول نقوي الصفقة... دايفر، مستوى ارتداد، متوسط
rules.pseudocode: score_confluence(divergence, fib_level, moving_average); never trigger without buyer_confirmation
